notes: Heir-owned. On first run the brain auto-discovers your AI-Memory cloud drive (OneDrive / Dropbox / iCloud etc). To pin a specific drive, set ai_memory_root to the folder name relative to your HOME directory (e.g. 'OneDrive - YourCompany'). To skip a known work drive during auto-discovery, add its folder name to ai_memory_exclude. Edition upgrades will never overwrite this file.
